title: My Family Dinner
paragraph: Every night, my family eats dinner together at six o'clock. My mother cooks rice and fish, and my father makes a fresh salad. My sister sets the table, and I pour the water. We talk about our day and share funny stories. After dinner, we wash the dishes together. I love this time with my family.
tongue_twisters: Fish and fresh fruit for Fran.
Mom makes me a mild, mushy meal.
We wash many white dishes.

title: The Library Visit
paragraph: On Wednesday, I go to the library after school. It is a quiet place with many tall shelves. I look for a book about animals and find one with a big lion on the cover. The librarian, Mrs. Rahman, helps me check it out. I sit by the window and read for an hour. Then I carry the book home with a smile.
tongue_twisters: Lions like long library books.
Read the red book by the window.
Tall shelves hold tiny tales.

title: Learning to Ride a Bike
paragraph: Last year, I learned to ride a bike. My uncle held the seat and ran beside me. At first, I wobbled and fell, but I did not give up. After a few days, I could ride all by myself. I felt so proud and happy. Now I ride to the shop every weekend.
tongue_twisters: Bike, bike, big blue bike.
Ravi rides his red bike round the road.
Wobbly wheels wander and wave.

title: A Visit to the Doctor
paragraph: Yesterday, I had a sore throat, so my mother took me to the doctor. The doctor was kind and spoke softly. She looked at my throat and checked my ears. Then she told me to rest and drink warm water. I took my medicine and slept early. Today, I feel much better.
tongue_twisters: The doctor drinks day-old, dull tea.
Soft sore throat, sip some soup.
Warm water works well.

title: My Favorite Season
paragraph: My favorite season is winter. The air is cool, and the mornings are foggy. I wear my warm jacket and a soft red scarf. At home, we drink hot milk and eat sweet pitha. The days are short, but the nights feel cozy. I love sitting near the window and watching the mist.
tongue_twisters: Cold, cozy winter mornings.
Sweet snacks for a snowy Sunday.
Misty mornings make me smile.

title: A New Student
paragraph: Today, a new student joined our class. His name is Omar, and he is from another city. He looked a little shy, so I smiled and said hello. We sat together at lunch and talked about cricket. By the end of the day, he was laughing with everyone. I think we will be good friends.
tongue_twisters: Omar often eats oranges at noon.
Shy students say hello slowly.
Kind kids keep calm.

title: Grandma's Garden
paragraph: My grandmother has a small garden behind her house. She grows red tomatoes, green beans, and yellow flowers. Every morning, she waters the plants with a little can. In the afternoon, I help her pick the ripe vegetables. We wash them and put them in a basket. Her garden is my favorite place to visit.
tongue_twisters: Grandma grows green grapes and good gourds.
Red tomatoes taste terrific.
Pick purple plums, please.

title: Watching a Movie
paragraph: On Friday night, we watch a movie at home. My brother makes popcorn, and I find the best seats on the sofa. We turn off the lights and turn up the sound. The story is funny, and we laugh a lot. At the end, we talk about our favorite parts. It is a perfect way to finish the week.
tongue_twisters: Pop, pop, popcorn pops.
Funny films make friends laugh.
Sit still, the show starts soon.

title: Saving Money
paragraph: I want to buy a new football, so I am saving my money. Every week, I put a little coin into a small blue box. I do not spend it on candy or toys. After two months, the box is almost full. I count the coins carefully and smile. Soon, I will have enough to buy the ball.
tongue_twisters: Save small coins, buy big balls.
Count the coins, one, two, three.
Blue box, big bag, brown book.

title: A Quiet Evening
paragraph: After school, I like to sit on the roof and watch the evening sky. The birds fly home, and the air feels cool. I can hear the call to prayer far away and the soft sound of traffic below. My mother brings me a cup of tea and a few biscuits. I sit quietly and think about my day. It is my favorite part of the evening.
tongue_twisters: Birds fly back to the big, bright sky.
Quiet evenings are calm and cool.
Tea and tiny biscuits for two.
